name: Compare and evaluate job roles and career prospects
description: Users asked to compare, evaluate, or analyze the characteristics, salaries, and prospects of various job roles, industries, or career paths, often considering factors such as personality traits, AI replaceability, or specific organizational contexts. Some users also requested the design of job analysis instruments or the ranking of tasks and tools based on professional relevance or difficulty.
